name: Block, Inc.
summary: Block, Inc., operating alongside its various subsidiaries, develops and provides tools that empower sellers to seamlessly accept card payments. These offerings include comprehensive reporting and analytics features, coupled with efficient, often next-day, fund settlements. The company offers a diverse range of hardware products designed for various payment methods. These include the Magstripe Reader for traditional swiped magnetic stripe cards; the Contactless and Chip Reader, which processes Europay, MasterCard, and Visa (EMV) chip cards as well as Near Field Communication (NFC) payments; the Square Stand, transforming an iPad into a versatile payment terminal or complete point-of-sale (POS) system; the Square Register, an integrated device combining its proprietary hardware, POS software, and payment technology; and the Square Terminal, a modern payment device with an integrated receipt printer that replaces conventional keypad terminals, supporting tap, dip, and swipe transactions. In addition to its hardware, Block provides an extensive suite of software applications. This includes Square Point of Sale, Square Appointments, Square for Retail, Square for Restaurants, Square Online and Square Online Checkout, Square Invoices, Square Virtual Terminal, Square Team Management, Square Contracts, Square Loyalty, Marketing, and Gift Cards, along with the Square Dashboard. Furthermore, the company maintains a developer platform, offering Application Programming Interfaces (APIs) and Software Development Kits (SDKs) for integration. Beyond its core payment and POS solutions, Block also provides Cash App, a mobile application enabling users to send, spend, and store money, and Weebly, which delivers website hosting and domain name registration services to its customers. Serving an international clientele, Block's presence extends across the United States, Canada, Japan, Australia, Ireland, France, Spain, and the United Kingdom. Originally founded in 2009 as Square, Inc. and headquartered in San Francisco, California, the company officially rebranded to Block, Inc. in December 2021.
